rows.label: PROPOSAL · the cold read's clarity fix (not in)
rows.text: That part doesn't have to move out. It's been living there way longer than the grown-up you. It can keep watch while you take one small step toward your little one, and I think watching is what it wants anyway, to see whether there's a grown-up here now who could call it off if things got to be too much. If it says no, I'd listen. When it lets you, keep an eye on that part too, for any change at all. If it's been calling all this stupid, it might turn out to be scared of getting its hopes up. I wouldn't want to get mine up either. I'd tell it something like, "You don't have to hope yet, I'll keep coming back even when I mess up." Sometimes it doesn't say anything back for a while.
